text:
marta_csm: Heads-up 5 Cedarwell Health renewal inbound. Procurement attached PO and asked for Net60, split invoices between US/EU, vendor_code CEDAR-INTL-09 (not in CRM), +40 seats, keep current unit price but roll to 12mo. They also asked if wed give a 3% discount if they prepay 6 months. Any immediate blockers?

leo_ae: On a call now  procurement says they prefer Net60 for AP reasons. They want PO visible in the signing envelope and invoices to go to two separate AR contacts. I'll ask if a single payor is possible and whether they can prepay 6mo.

clare_fin: Net60 + split invoicing is doable but more complex. Need: 1) legal entity names per invoice, 2) tax IDs (US EIN and EU VAT), 3) confirmation of which entity will accept liability. Prepay discount ok but Finance needs currency and amount to run FX/treasury calc. If they insist on split and Net60, we may require credit approval or partial prepayment.

ben_legal: Amendment to the existing agreement is simplest for seat add + term change. Confirm if the EU split affects VAT or data-processing terms. DocuSign is fine; if they insist on wet-signature advise it adds 3-7 biz days for courier/retention. Also check vendor_code mapping to billing entity.

ana_enable: If they add seats we can provide one onboarding kickoff + 8 hours of enablement. If they prepay we can add an extra 2 hours. Holding tentative slots in week-of-June 7 pending PO confirmation.

marta_csm: Copy of procurement email: "VendorCode: CEDAR-INTL-09; PO# 552211; prefer Net60; Invoice split 60% Cedarwell US (ap@cedar.us) / 40% Cedarwell EU (ap-eu@cedar.eu); will sign via DocuSign; may request prepay for 6mo with discount."

clare_fin: CEDAR-INTL-09 not in our vendor registry. Leo  ask for tax IDs and legal entity names. Also ask if AP will act as consolidated payor or strictly split. If split, we need separate billing contacts and the SOW must map allocation percentages.

leo_ae: Will request TAX IDs and liability confirmation on the call in 20m. Pushing for single payor; procurement says "we'll try" but not guaranteed.

signbot: DocuSign draft amendment created (internal preview): https://docusign.example/envelope/cedar-456 5 fields: PO attachment, billing entity selector, percentage allocation, signers.

ben_legal: I'll review the draft. If EU entity named is outside EU VAT MOSS scope, flag to tax counsel. Also note any DPAs if customer wants data routing specifics.

clare_fin: If they prepay 6mo we can offer 3% discount but Finance needs exact prepay amount and currency to approve. For Net60 on split invoices we may need a credit check or a payment guarantee.

ana_enable: Tentatively reserving onboarding trainer slots. Please lock by EOD Tue if they confirm seats.

leo_ae: Update from procurement call: provided US EIN 11-2223334 and EU VAT GB999888777. They said consolidating payor is unlikely but will confirm. PO# 552211 will be attached to the envelope. They tentatively accept 3% prepay discount if we can invoice net of discount.

marta_csm: Great 5 I'll mark "vendor_code mismatch" as high risk until vendor registry updated, "Net60 + split invoices" as medium risk. If Finance requires credit checks or guarantee, will delay DocuSign send by 24-48h.

clare_fin: Got the IDs  thanks. If payor remains split, Finance needs paperwork for both entities and separate invoice lines. If they prepay, we can fast-track credit. Please confirm currency and whether EU portion will be invoiced in EUR or USD.

ben_legal: Reviewing internal draft now. If they request any changes to indemnity or data clauses for the EU entity, escalate to me immediately. Otherwise amendment looks standard.

leo_ae: I'll push for single payor and currency details. If procurement confirms split payor, I'll ask for AP contact names and invoicing GL codes so Ops can route correctly.

marta_csm: Thanks team. Target: send DocuSign within 48h if all docs present; +3-7 biz days if wet-sign or credit/guarantee needed. I'll update renewal tracker and ping when envelope goes out.
